study_title: Quality-Oriented Engineering Change Dynamics in Apache Projects
design: Secondary observational analysis of 2,533 manually coded commits from 54 Java Apache projects
source_name: SmartSHARK commit-intent replication dataset (Trautsch et al.)
license_note: Open Zenodo research dataset; cite the original authors and follow the record reuse terms.
claim_boundary: Commit intent is not equivalent to requirement change, design rework, or downstream cost/schedule impact. The empirical title is intentionally narrower: claims concern coded change orientation in this sample of Apache projects.
